#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Create an OpenFOAM 10 (Foundation) case for laminar, compressible flow
over a forward-facing step using the rhoCentralFoam solver.

Run the generated Allrun script to execute the case.
"""

import os
import math

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Case configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CASE_DIR = os.path.abspath(os.getcwd())
SOLVER   = "rhoCentralFoam"
END_TIME = 4.0
DELTA_T  = 0.002
WRITE_INTERVAL = 0.1  # writes every 0.1 s

# Geometry (forward-facing step)
DOMAIN_X = 1.0      # streamwise length
DOMAIN_Y = 0.4      # height of the domain
STEP_X   = 0.3      # x position of the step
STEP_Y   = 0.1      # step height

# Flow conditions
U_INLET   = 2.7
T_INLET   = 1.0
P_INLET   = 101325.0

# Gas properties (close to air but reduced to make the case cheap)
GAMMA = 1.4
R     = 287.0  # J/(kg K)
Cv    = R / (GAMMA - 1.0)
Cp    = GAMMA * Cv

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def write(path, content):
    full = os.path.join(CASE_DIR, path)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(full), exist_ok=True)
    with open(full, "w") as f:
        f.write(content)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0/ - initial and boundary fields
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
write(
    "0/U",
    """/*--------------------------------*- C++ -*----------------------------------*\\
| =========                 |                                                 |
| \\\\      /  F ield         | OpenFOAM: The Open Source CFD Toolbox           |
|  \\\\    /   O peration     | Version:  10                                    |
|   \\\\  /    A nd           | Website:  www.openfoam.com                      |
|    \\\\/     M anipulation  |                                                 |
\\*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
FoamFile
{
    version     2.0;
    format      ascii;
    class       volVectorField;
    object      U;
}
